turnout.title: Turnout: Palestinian citizens of Israel and all voters, 2019–2022
turnout.question: Share of registered voters who voted.
turnout.note: IDI's term is "Arab" turnout, measured in Arab and Druze localities; Druze localities cannot be separated out in this series. The all-voters column is from the CEC results files (https://data.gov.il/dataset/votes-knesset)

towns.title: How these towns voted, 2019–2022 (% of valid votes, leading lists)
towns.question: Share of valid votes cast in each town, computed from the Central Elections Committee's locality results files. These are town results, not the vote of a group.
towns.source: Central Elections Committee, results by locality (computed)
towns.note: Lists as they ran each year. April 2019: two pairs, Hadash–Ta'al and Ra'am–Balad. September 2019 and March 2020: one Joint List of Hadash, Ta'al, Balad and Ra'am. March 2021: Ra'am ran alone; the Joint List was Hadash, Ta'al and Balad. 2022: three separate lists. In 2026 the Joint List name returns for Hadash, Ta'al and Balad, with Ra'am separate. Shefa-Amr has a Druze minority, which the town figures cannot separate

killed.title: Palestinian citizens of Israel killed in crime and violence, by year
killed.question: People killed in crime and violence; the report's term is "Arab citizens."
killed.source: Abraham Initiatives, 2025 Crime and Violence Report
killed.note: The 2025 bar is the report's figure to December 28; the Abraham Initiatives homepage (https://abrahaminitiatives.org/) gives 255 for the full year. The same report's age table gives 124 for 2021 and 251 for 2025

identity-component.title: Palestinian citizens of Israel: the most important component of personal identity
identity-component.question: What is the most important component of your personal identity? (one choice)
identity-component.source: Konrad Adenauer Program for Jewish-Arab Cooperation, Moshe Dayan Center, Tel Aviv University
identity-component.sample: about 500 per wave, by phone in Arabic; ±4.4 points
identity-component.note: The source's term is "Arab citizens"; the sample includes Druze, who put Israeli citizenship first (64.8% in May 2026), and no total without them is published. May 2023 and May 2026: KAP May 2026 report. Dec 2024: Times of Israel on the KAP survey (https://www.timesofisrael.com/survey-finds-arab-israelis-show-growing-sense-of-shared-destiny-since-outbreak-of-war/). Nov 2025: KAP Nov 2025 report (https://dayan.org/file-download/download/public/18732). A Nov 2023 wave is left out because its report was not found

identity-label.title: Palestinian citizens of Israel: self-description when offered labels, 2019
identity-label.question: How respondents defined themselves, among these labels; the source reports the labels and shares but does not print the question wording.
identity-label.source: Sammy Smooha, Index of Arab-Jewish Relations, in Fathom
identity-label.note: A different question from the identity-component series above, and older than two years; it is the newest survey found that offers these labels. The source's term is "Arab citizens"
